scope: Current tracked repository, independent baseline and architecture review, focused cloud/body investigation and parent validation.

findings.fix: Accumulate accepted request bytes in one bounded bytearray and replay once. Preserve the inclusive 1 MiB limit, incomplete-body disconnects, subsequent receive events and non-HTTP passthrough.

local_verification.browser: passed on isolated port 18182 with temporary state

controlled_fragment_regression.mode: controlled ASGI input, not wire exhaustion
regressions: Fragmented input preserves exact bytes with frame-independent allocation bound.
Exactly 1 MiB succeeds; the next byte rejects before downstream processing.
Disconnect before request completion cannot authorize a mutation.
Non-HTTP scopes and subsequent receive events retain their semantics.

limits: Default listener/Compose exposure is loopback; no Internet deployment assumed.
Wire exhaustion thresholds and practical fragment pacing were not measured.
Cloud target, approval, dispatch and reconciliation source had no supported bypass in this audit.
The existing AWS receipt covers earlier unchanged connector source; Azure/GCP live verification and independent-human approval remain unverified.
Local evidence chains, trusted host/configuration and provider administrative races retain documented limits.
hosted_ci: The current Verify workflow run identifies the final published commit.
